tagline: A digital companion, now in your world.
about: A live Digital Partner game inside the Courage smartphone Digivice. Pick it up, interact with your pet, and keep it nearby in VR. The grab bar supports depth adjustment, and a shake sends it home. Off stops the game and its audio. Your saved game stays in this creation’s private data directory.
